text:
Jamie: Heads-up — dashboards are missing inference spans from Go services after the OTLP rollout. Saw traces for Python/Rust but Go only shows connection-open events.
Sara: We changed the resource attrs and sampler defaults in the init shim; can you paste a minimal example of what you're using in Go? :thinking: 
Jamie: Sure — go.opentelemetry.io/otel v1.9, using otlpgrpc exporter with BatchSpanProcessor. Init snippet:
```go
ctx := context.Background()
exp, _ := otlptracegrpc.New(ctx)
p := sdktrace.NewBatchSpanProcessor(exp)
tracerProvider := sdktrace.NewTracerProvider(sdktrace.WithSampler(sdktrace.AlwaysSample()), sdktrace.WithSpanProcessor(p))
otel.SetTracerProvider(tracerProvider)
```
Sara: That looks fine. Two things we hit: (1) resource attrs missing `service.name` and `deployment.environment` — dashboards group by those, (2) BatchSpanProcessor defaults vary slightly by SDK — Go's default maxQueueSize is smaller and scheduleDelay is longer. Try setting explicit options: NewBatchSpanProcessor(exp, sdktrace.WithMaxQueueSize(2048), sdktrace.WithScheduleDelayMillis(250))
Mike: Also, KV-cache spans must carry `redwood.kv.prefix` and `redwood.inference.request_id` as span attributes so Search can join spans to cache ops. Otherwise the cost dashboards can't link token counts.
Ravi: On exporters/retention — we're seeing loss during high QPS because exporter queue fills and drops. Switch otlp exporter to use `otlphttp` with `max_retries` and set env OTEL_BSP_MAX_QUEUE_SIZE=4096 for python/go and in rust set `max_queue_size = 4096` in tracer config. Persisted queue is risky for us.
Jamie: Quick test command I ran: `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=https://otel.redwood.prod:4318 OTEL_BSP_MAX_QUEUE_SIZE=4096 ./server` — after that Go traces started appearing.
Sara: We should standardize initialization across languages in the init shim repo: add explicit resource attrs, fixed BatchSpanProcessor params, and an instrumentation wrapper that injects `redwood.*` attrs for inference requests. I'll add a PR.
Mike: +1. Also add a tiny python snippet for context propagation with KV cache:
```py
with tracer.start_as_current_span("kv.get", attributes={"redwood.kv.prefix": prefix, "redwood.inference.request_id": req_id}):
    val = cache.get(key)
```
Ravi: Note for retention: exporter-level sampling before export reduces storage cost. We can add a pre_export_sampler that drops debug spans (`span.kind == "internal" and span.name == "debug"`).
otel-bot: deploy bot: Deployment rolled out to canary (infra/otel-init-shim) — 1865001305 :rocket: 
Jamie: Thanks — will validate in canary and report back.
Sara: ping me if you see missing `service.name` values — I'll add a health check for resource attrs.
